title: TTLCache returns an item at exactly its expiry time
body:
`TTLCache` in `cachetools/__init__.py` treats an item as expired once
`timer() >= expires` (that is what `key in cache` reports), but
`cache[key]` still returns it at exactly the expiry time:

```python
>>> now = [0]
>>> cache = TTLCache(maxsize=4, ttl=10, timer=lambda: now[0])
>>> cache["k"] = "v"
>>> now[0] = 10
>>> "k" in cache
False
>>> cache["k"]
'v'     # expected KeyError
```

Expected: at and after `insert time + ttl` the item is gone for
`cache[key]` and `cache.get(key)` as well; before that it is
returned.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file
